title: Wren and the Promise
author: Yara Okonkwo
blurb: Mara Amberdale, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
